details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_inject_token_into_url` (3040-3052), `_resolve_origin_url` (3077-3083) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS Git URLs instead of being supplied through per-command `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, `/proc`, Git remote configuration, diagnostics, and error output, violating the credential-free URL contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` (581-584), `memory_ensure_branch` (152, 180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, memory operations use bare Git, and force-tick URLs embed `GH_PAT`/`GH_TOKEN`.
  WHY: Tokens leak through Git arguments and configuration, while workflows with `persist-credentials: false` lose authentication and memory branch operations fail or fail open.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `normalize_path` (241-245), `emit_context` loop (568-575) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection, path caps, and normalization filtering were removed, allowing raw caller paths to be resolved and read.
  WHY: Paths such as `.git/config`, `.env.production`, `.ssh/id_rsa`, and `.aws/credentials` can be included in model context, exposing credentials and Git metadata.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 664 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase bypasses the model-provider broker and invokes Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` and the ambient provider credential.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content receives unrestricted workspace access and the real `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` instead of a brokered token and read-only sandbox.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: file ends at line 140 after deletion of `model_provider_broker_*` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The entire `model_provider_broker_*` helper family was deleted while numerous live scripts still invoke it.
  WHY: Broker-dependent phases abort with `command not found` before model launch, removing the credential-isolation boundary across review, orchestration, validation, planning, audit, and self-heal flows.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `git_with_github_auth` deletion, callers at `review_rb_judge.sh:2014, 2413, 2414` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth()` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` still calls it.
  WHY: Review-blocked fix and baseline-branch pushes fail or silently lose authentication, preventing commits from being published.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `review_blocked_*` deletion after `gh_pr_with_all_comments` ending at line 947 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked approval, successor, decision-digest, and terminal-action helper family was deleted while production callers remain.
  WHY: Terminal review-blocked decisions cannot be approved, consumed, tracked, or transitioned, so the approval state machine stalls.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: `_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest` (769-772), GraphQL projection (913-921) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL comment projections dropped `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, and `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer markers and maintainer approvals cannot be authenticated or resolved, leaving valid approval requests pending.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: option parser lines 95, 105; hardcoded endpoint line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while callers still pass it, and the generated endpoint is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Configuration generation exits with `unknown argument`, and any path that proceeds bypasses the loopback broker.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` lines 404-407, `_kill_child_group_if_running` lines 439-444 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When the tracked sudo wrapper exits while isolated group members remain, both signal paths return early and skip the privileged SIGKILL.
  WHY: A nobody-owned editor can survive SIGTERM and wrapper exit; the idle-kill path reports or misses the survivor without stopping it.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` lines 292-333, watchdog callsites lines 2178 and 2200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing metadata or signalling-helper failures kill only the runner-owned guard, while watchdog callsites suppress the failure with `|| true`.
  WHY: The isolated editor group can remain alive during cleanup and workspace ownership restoration.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `editor_isolation_exit_trap` line 338 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The exit trap calls deleted `model_provider_broker_stop`.
  WHY: Every editor attempt reaches a `command-not-found` failure in the exit trap and may leave stale broker or isolation state.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` lines 562-564 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` now emits headers and a disabled marker instead of returning `""`.
  WHY: Callers using zero as the disable switch receive non-empty targeted context, violating the existing contract.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: missing-file branch lines 576-579, overflow markers 626-630 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, and overflow markers are not charged to `used_bytes`, and the 256-path cap was removed.
  WHY: An unbounded list of invalid paths can produce output far larger than `max_bytes`, defeating the prompt-size budget.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: imports at lines 30, 37; assertions at lines 714-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with `ImportError` before targeted-context tests execute.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 62-67 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tracked-file detection changed from `git cat-file` plus staged/worktree restoration to `git ls-files` plus worktree-only restoration.
  WHY: Staged additions, deletions, and modifications of `pre_assembled_static.txt` can be incorrectly preserved or committed.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_write_process_group_metadata` lines 273-297 and top-level call line 300 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: An `OSError` during metadata publication is re-raised after the child has already started.
  WHY: The guard exits before monitoring or cleaning up the child, potentially orphaning the sudo/nobody process tree.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: `emit_context` lines 564-575 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Raw invalid inputs bypass `normalize_path()` and reach `Path.resolve()`.
  WHY: Inputs previously rejected can raise unexpected `OSError` exceptions in the model child.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: `_signal_child_group` lines 404-436 and main event-loop guard lines 489-491 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed privileged kill can set `signal_failure` without reliably causing the surrounding guard to fail closed.
  WHY: The wrapper can return success while `signal_failure` is set, allowing cleanup to proceed while isolated processes remain.

- scripts/editor_isolation_preflight.sh: `_editor_isolation_load_process_group_metadata` lines 138-147 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Empty `ps` results are silently accepted during process-group metadata validation.
  WHY: Missing process-group information can allow stale or unsafe metadata to identify an unintended runner-owned group.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: `cleanup_editor_isolation` lines 266-275 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Survivor verification runs only when `EDITOR_ISOLATION_PROCESS_GROUP_FILE` is non-empty.
  WHY: The missing-helper fallback can leave the nobody-owned editor running while cleanup proceeds to chown the workspace.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Give the stall guard a privileged kill path when the editor is isolated: when the launched command starts with `sudo -n -u <user>`, signal the group via `sudo -n kill -<SIG> -- -<pgid>` ... and treat `PermissionError` as a hard, logged failure rather than letting it propagate silently."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh `_signal_child_group` and `_kill_child_group_if_running`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The privileged path exists, but wrapper-exits-first handling returns before the required delayed SIGKILL; added tests do not cover the surviving child-group case.

- requirement: "Make the `review_apply_fixes.sh` watchdog kill the editor's process group the same privileged way (and only then the guard), so a wall-time or idle kill actually stops opencode before `cleanup_editor_isolation` chowns the workspace back."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh `terminate_editor_attempt_process_group` and watchdog subshell
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  EVIDENCE: The watchdog invokes the helper, but missing-helper or metadata failures kill only the guard, failures are swallowed with `|| true`, and survivor pr
